statement: HHD uses a Deck-derived 28de:12ff USB-bus UHID persona and nine attribute records with unconditional SET success; InputPlumber uses a non-1205 compatibility PID for Steam Deck UHID and records a Steam interface-number gate for real 1205; SC Controller uses uinput Xbox/desktop identities. OpenPuck 1304 is receiver hardware and does not establish 1302 UHID acceptance. HIDMaestro declares a direct 1302 USB/IP persona with five attributes and additional string-index replies, but self-reported support does not independently prove why it was listed.
